newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks soar to unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks soar to unofficial record close.

text.p: The Mexican bourse trimmed earlier gains, but still closed far ahead of the recent crop of records on Tuesday.
Analysts said domestic and foreign dealers flooded the market to buy ahead of predicted improvements in second quarter earnings amid euphoria following mid-term elections held on Sunday.
Preliminary figures placed the leading IPC share index up 77.15 points on the day, or 1.63 percent, at 4,818.39 when the closing bell rang.
